name: Equilibria transferable-share reward replay
summary: VaultEPendle updated reward debt only in deposit, withdraw and getReward, not on share transfers, and getReward(account) was public. The attacker deposited, moved the shares to fresh helper contracts and claimed for each, so every receiver was paid the full accumulated reward per share again, then pulled the shares back and repeated.
notes: Copycat contract creations 0xa4dcf148 and 0x17e0c488 only sent ETH into the vault. The next replays took that ETH out again, so the ETH loss is the vault's drop over the campaign (13.603 to 0.004 ETH) rather than the sum of per-transaction outflows (rule 11: attacker deposits are not victim assets).

In 0x45047ffa the vault also paid EQB and xEQB rewards. The xEQB stayed in the 14 helper contracts because xEQB cannot be transferred, so the attacker realised nothing from it and it is valued at zero (rule 12).
The anchor and the three replays are the only transactions since the vault's deployment in which an account received vault shares by transfer and was paid rewards in the same transaction.
